name: ECOChat Pangeanic
author: Pangeanic

sections.description:
Pangeanic produces RAG-based Adaptive GenAI for AI Chatbots and next-generation machine translation processes.

Our AI chatbots can be built with your website data in one hour using our own LLM for private generation – there’s no data transfer to third parties. Inject private documents and reports to create full AI assistants that respect privacy. Save thousands of hours managing internal and external searches for information and client and staff queries. Your data remains private and accessible throughout your organization. Hallucinations, typical of general systems, disappear.

Use Adaptive GenAI for LLM-based translation and automatic post-editing.

How it Works

We personalize our AI’s knowledge with the public content of the target website provided by the client, providing you with an apikey with which you can configure and activate the chat.

The Terms and Conditions and Privacy Policy

  • https://pangeanic.com/terms-and-conditions

Privacy Statement

  • https://pangeanic.com/privacy-statement

External Service

=Descriptions Links=

External links are used for plugin configuration, and communication with the chatbot.

https://api.pangeanic.com/service/ecochat/api/v1/auth/login: Allows authentication using credentials (email and password).
https://api.pangeanic.com/service/ecochat/api/v1/instances: Returns instance data.
https://api.pangeanic.com/service/ecochat/api/v1/{instance_id}/assistants: Returns assistant’s data of an instance.
https://api.pangeanic.com/service/ecochat/api/v1/sessions: Returns session data.
https://api.pangeanic.com/service/ecochat/api/v1/new-question: Creates a new question.
https://api.pangeanic.com/service/ecochat/api/v1/feedback: Sends feedback or suggestions.

Request Access via email and password

Visit the site https://pangeamt.com or https://pangeanic.com to contact support
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or greater

Recommended Requirements

  • PHP version 7.4 or greater

Installation

  1. Install using the WordPress built-in Plugin installer, or Extract the zip file and drop the contents in the wp-content/plugins/ directory of your WordPress installation.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Menu > ‘ECOChat Pangeanic’.
  4. Log in with the email and password provided by pangeanic and save.

How do I request an email and password?

  • Visit the site https://pangeamt.com/ or https://pangeanic.com to contact support
